messages:
Priya (Design): Quick design huddle: new Autoscale row mock uploaded. Main asks: make SLO slider mode explicit, tighten min/max stepper copy, surface burst billing sooner, and ensure linear keyboard/tab order. Thoughts?
Noah (Frontend): Good list. Questions: should SLO slider snap to presets or allow free drag? Snapping helps clarity but breaks fine-tune. Also moving burst out of the card improves visibility but adds a row height tradeoff.
Sam (PM): Prefer snap-to-presets for first pass (less accidental cost). We can enable a small 'edit' to go custom. Also require a guardrail when burst >40% with hover tooltip: "Estimated cost impact".
Ava (A11Y): Accessibility notes: slider needs aria-valuetext that includes mode (e.g., "200ms, preset"); the burst toggle should be a real button with aria-pressed and a clear focus ring. Contrast for burst pill must be >=4.5:1. Avoid relying on color alone for state.
Jae (Eng): Backend concerns: presets should map to preset_id. Free-form custom should store numeric values. Burst_quota must be capped by pool.max_gpus and validated server-side. We'll return a warning code (409) when requested burst > pool_max to show the inline nudge.
Lina (Data): If we add guardrail messaging, can we log when users override it? We should track "burst_override" events with delta and cost_estimate for later analysis.
Priya (Design): Microcopy proposals: Burst label -> "Burst capacity"; tooltip -> "Temporary extra GPUs for traffic spikes. Billed while active." SLO slider modes labelled as: Off / Preset: <name> / Custom. For the stepper microcopy put help text: "Min/Max set the guaranteed pool floor and ceiling."
Noah (Frontend): I'll implement snap-to-presets plus an inline "Edit" button that converts to a numeric input. For keyboard: DOM order will be pool picker -> burst button -> SLO slider -> min/max. I will add role="slider" with aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext.
Ava (A11Y): Good. Also add live region updates when the cost-estimate changes: aria-live="polite" with text like "Estimated monthly cost: $X". Ensure screen reader users get the guardrail messaging.
Sam (PM): UX decision: when pool capacity insufficient, show soft nudge: "This SLO may need more capacity — view options" and a button "Compare costs" that opens cost modal populated by cost-estimator API. No auto-migration.
Jae (Eng): We'll wire cost-estimator to the slider events but debounce to 500ms. Also feature-flag the UI behind "autoscale-v2" for staged rollout.
Noah (Frontend): Plan: prototype in staging behind flag, include keyboard checks and a11y attributes. Will push PR and ask Design for a quick run-through.
deploy-bot: deploy/ui-staging v2.24.1 succeeded — https://staging.redwood.dev/deploys/4412
Priya (Design): Thanks team. I'll update FigJam and add the a11y checklist (contrast value, aria examples, focus order). Ping me when staging flag is on and I'll run a 10-minute test. :seedling:
